verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an implementation-relevant visual-design constraint that the other company website must not shape the landing-page design.
The client selects concrete landing-page visual behavior covering concepts, dark theme, hero color and emphasis, headline typography, and button color.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim for the complete landing-page mock-up, explicitly reporting Alan Sans headers and incorporated imagery.
This adds a distinct live-implementation transition: the client reports developing the landing-page design and deploying the resulting page through S3 and CloudFront.
The client explicitly changes the rendered landing-page section spacing by directing that previously tightened spacing be opened slightly; no prior state key becomes obsolete.
